motions.impact: With this, the written record of that meeting becomes official. It is a step for the clerk, not for you.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City amending the Fiscal Yea…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City amending the Fiscal Year 2018-2019 Budget. Board Member Reaves seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, Donna Burnham, and Benjamin Reaves. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: 2018-19 agency budget trued up at year end
motions.summary: The agency board made a final change to its 2018-2019 budget to reflect higher values in the 2012-1 economic development area and the Parkside project area.
motions.impact: Bookkeeping that catches the agency's accounts up to values already on the ground in those two project areas. You will not see it anywhere.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the Fis…
motions.motion: Board Member Reaves moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the Fiscal Year 2019-2020 Budget. Board Member Curtis seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, Donna Burnham, and Benjamin Reaves. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Agency budget adopted for 2019-20
motions.summary: The agency board adopted its budget for the 2019-2020 fiscal year, which staff said was identical to the versions presented earlier.
motions.impact: This budget spends the redevelopment agency's own tax increment money, not city service dollars. Staff said the figures rest on projections and may be amended as parts of the city grow.
